evidence: feeOnTop unsigned but limitAmount IS signed and enforced. Input: feeOnTop reduces swap input, limitAmount caps min output. Output: feeOnTop adds to input, limitAmount caps max input. FeeHelper:53-57 reverts if feeOnTop > amountInAfterFees.

thesis: Spoof executor context to redirect settlement to attacker address
evidence: Executor passed from AMM msg.sender. Cosignature includes executor address, verified against cosigner signature. Cannot spoof without valid cosignature.

evidence: Order nonces auto-increment via nextOrderNonce++ (CLOBTransferHandler:538). Monotonically increasing, never reused. closeOrder sets inputAmount=0 preventing double-close.

thesis: Redirect hook fees to attacker address via configuration manipulation

evidence: ERC-1271 contract can only sign permits FOR ITSELF (the from address). Attacker would only drain their own tokens.

evidence: afterSwapRefund checks msg.sender != AMM -> revert CallbackMustBeFromAMM. No external path bypasses this.

evidence: from address is part of PermitC signed data (token field in PermitTransferFrom struct). Changing from invalidates signature.

thesis: Bypass pricing bounds via computeRatioX96 zero return
evidence: Halmos C16: for all uint256 inputs, computeRatioX96 returns 0 (overflow sentinel, caught by min bound) or valid ratio. Fuzz C17: for uint128 inputs, never returns 0.
